text: Redmond Rovers press high up the pitch near Ironvale Athletic’s goal at the right end, controlling possession with quick passes around the midfield and left flank inside the opposing half. They make 10 final third entries in eight minutes while keeping the ball mainly in Ironvale’s half. Their high defensive line and pressing force Ironvale back, disrupting counter-attacks. Nico Okafor’s shot from outside the box on the right side is blocked, showing Redmond’s sustained pressure despite trailing 0-1 [#78].
